result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is a layout alignment problem in the 'Fastest near you' carousel: the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) has an image and text block that are vertically offset compared to its neighboring cards, making the row look visually inconsistent.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card is vertically misaligned relative to its neighbors: its image starts lower and is shorter, and its title/delivery fee text sits noticeably lower than the aligned titles of 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola', breaking the horizontal rhythm of the row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in the horizontal carousel share a consistent height, image aspect ratio, and padding so the delivery time badge, title, and delivery fee align across all cards.
